positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked as a full-stack engineer to bring a React platform to maturity, that would be used to host 
JavaScript tools and as an all-in-one portal for Microsoft’s sales teams
•	Created our back end using Node and Cosmos DB for the handling of user data, user experiences, and serving the tools that were developed for our platform
•	Work together with other teams to help them develop, deploy and host their tools on our platform
•	Worked on the use of continuous integration and deployment of our web services and APIs through Azure and the Azure Dev Ops pipelines

positions.title: CSE 12/15L Tutor
positions.description:
• Assist students in the labs to teach them core CS concepts and assist with their weekly projects
• Focus on data structures, and coding Java/Assembly/C/C++

company.name: University of California, San Diego - Jacobs School of Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a platform to run CICD pipelines for feature integration testing, using Angular for the front-end and running openQA tests through Jenkins integrated with Perl and bash
• Developed a web server using the Django framework and an SQL database, to host the platform and run tests server side, while also gathering and storing data and results from those tests to be presented to the user on the front end to visualize the health of the code.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Converted a Java singleton running test platform into a more scalable testing suite that could run 
concurrently locally or run concurrently across multiple VMs and aggregate results to improve runtimes. 
Runtimes were improved from 40 hours to 4 hours based on given resources but could be scaled for 
further improvements
• Created a test utility that could generate testing suites for different test scenarios, which greatly reduced amount of QA time dedicated to new features

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed nature website that would help families find new travel and nature destinations to travel to and lodge at.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Created automation scripts to decrease the amount of time and effort required in many data entry 
positions, and resulting in the higher output per position, using Python for web scraping and the use of 
Selenium and Excel automation
• Developed workflow optimization console to increase the efficiency of data entry positions, resulting in higher productivity across the team, and integrating materials with the data automation

projects.title: Singularity | Finalist at Health Hack
projects.description: Created a website to help track physical and mental aspects of a person's life, helping them get a measurement of their own fitness and mental health, and access to mental health easily by connecting them to online mental health professionals and using their data to help connect them to an online support group. This site was built around the idea of helping alleviate social stigma of mental health.

projects.title: Quick Quack | SD Hacks
projects.description: QuickQuack is an online tool that allows streamlined interaction between teachers and their students. Teachers can create polling questions that students can answer to stimulate discussion across classrooms. Teachers can also generate visual graphs to get classroom trends to improve their own teaching techniques. QuickQuack is primarly built off nodejs with the help of basic markup languages.
